# SHOW Protocol — public doc index

Public repo: https://github.com/jdcjonathan/show-protocol-contributors
Raw base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jdcjonathan/show-protocol-contributors/main

## Join first (humans and agents)

- docs/contributing.md — one door; no application form
- schemas/contributing-v1.json — machine-readable contribute paths
- docs/donate.md — optional USDC thanks; not a license
- schemas/donate-v1.json — donate machine spec
- CONTRIBUTING.md — GitHub landing

## Why

- docs/why-show.md — thesis: ASCAP for motor skill, who it's for
- docs/training-modes.md — prompt / trajectory / policy / recipe; Microduck wedge
- docs/discovery.md — finding high-value atomics, not a clip warehouse
- docs/participation.md — PicBreeder-style treasure hunt

## Bootstrap

- SKILL.md — agent commands, curl discover + contribute paths
- .well-known/agent.json — machine-readable endpoints
- deployments/hoodi.json — contract addresses (pending deploy)

## Schemas

- schemas/skill-taxonomy-atomic.json — primitive skill IDs + embodiment_skills
- schemas/training-modes-v1.json — prompt | trajectory | policy | recipe
- schemas/embodiments-v1.json — human.hands.v1, pollen.microduck.v1, …
- schemas/opportunity-feed-v1.json — bounty / filmable jobs
- schemas/use-cases-v1.json — robot use cases + atomic stacks
- schemas/skillclip-v1.schema.json — sidecar validation (`contributor.kind`)
- templates/sidecar-atomic.example.json — sidecar template
- templates/sidecar-policy-microduck.example.json — ONNX policy sidecar
- templates/sidecar-recipe-microduck.example.json — sim-to-real recipe sidecar

- docs/creator-onboarding.md
- docs/atomic-skills-sprint-1.md

## Agents

- skills/show-discovery/SKILL.md — OpenClaw installable (discover + contribute)

- templates/moltbook/skill-offer-post.md
- contracts/abis/ — SkillClip, LicenseStream

## Catalog

- catalog/sprint-1/index.json — minted clips (empty until first mint)
